items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: And when Harold couldn't come, that's how Tat came into the picture.

ctx.x: And by me being in New Orleans, every day, I could contact Harold, mostly any time I want, I used to catch him by the Whitney Bank. By the Whitney Bank, yeah. Yeah, because I used to carry a railroad mail there all the time. That's right. Yeah. So we worked together for many, many years, I'll put it to that. And, uh, yeah. And when Harold couldn't come, that's how Tat came into the picture. Yeah, I said Tat. He sent Tat once or twice. Who's Tat? Adolf Alexander. Are you trying to think of his name? Adolf…
